source: U.S. Census Bureau, Frequently Occurring Surnames from the 2010 Census
selection: First 1000 rows by ascending positive census rank; exclude the rank-zero ALL OTHER NAMES aggregate. Preserve source ordering for tied ranks.
display: Capitalize the first letter and lowercase the remaining source surname letters. Do not infer internal capitalization.
licenseScope: The official Data.gov catalogue record for this federal agency dataset explicitly declares CC0 1.0. The source consists of aggregate name statistics, not person-level records.
attribution: Source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2010 Census surname data. Selection and display casing by this library.
